summary: Replication receivers reject expired exchanges before receipt writes begin and return signed retryable overload responses for receive deadlines and local receive timeouts. Once a receipt commits, follow-up work completes so duplicate retries remain cheap.

replay.detail: Receipts remain atomic and retries use existing envelope deduplication.

schema.detail: No table, index or migration change.

compatibility.detail: An optional connector-to-daemon deadline header changes only the local process contract. Missing headers preserve existing behavior; older daemons ignore the header. Signed peer messages are unchanged.

recovery.detail: Expired exchanges rejected before receipt writes remain unacknowledged. Committed receipts finish validation, repair and projection; retries use existing deduplication without repeating those phases.
